_note: Scenario content pass, poured in through the editor's own import path (docs/design/CAMPAIGN_FEED.md; applied by pipeline/scenario_content.py --apply-feed). Sources: campaign guide v0.5 (sections 3, 5, 6, 9), encounter v0.4 (sections 1-7), CO-002. Decisions and ambiguities: docs/design/CONTENT_DECISIONS.md. CONTAINS SPOILERS.

cards.name: The Square
cards.text: Every loop begins here. Travel between districts along a connection costs 1 Hour (a Skip).
cards.flavor: Everyone is out for the occultation. None of them will look at you twice — not this time, not ever.

cards.text: When reached: add 1 Static token to the chaos bag until the next reset. If the log shows "What the Almanac Hid," instead each investigator removes 1 Static token.
When reached: the Appointed's Approach advances to at least Emerging (Hour VIII advances it to Arrived). If the log shows "The Appointed's Name," it arrives exhausted.

cards.back_text:
Calm side: use it from setup once the log shows "The Lamp Was Never Lit."
[action] Light the lamp (no test). While it is lit this loop, Echoes at connected districts stay Sleepwalking one band longer, and The Dark That Waits treats investigators here as not at the Lantern Room.
cards.back_flavor: You know how to light it now. Some part of you always did.

cards.text: [action] Test [agi] (2) to climb. If you fail, take 1 damage.

cards.flavor: Ayako has read every book in it a hundred times.

cards.text: Objective — With 2 [perinv] or more clues discovered in this district, set the Press to reprint the true time. Record "What the Almanac Hid."
Sealed until the log shows "What the Almanac Hid" and "The Vote That Never Ends." Deep objective — Recover the name (3 clues here). Record "The Appointed's Name." The finale is declared here.

cards.name: The First Hour
cards.text:
Objective — Once 5 clues have been gathered in total, an investigator at the Almanac Steps may resolve the Occultation (no test). When they do, read "The First Reset" (the objective was completed).
If the Hourglass reaches Hour IX first, read "The First Reset" anyway.
cards.flavor: The almanac promised the occultation at midnight. It is eleven, and the sky is already wrong.

cards.name: The First Reset
cards.text:
Each investigator gains 2 banked Memory. If the objective was completed, gain 1 more banked Memory.
Record "You Are Unstuck" in the campaign log. Act I begins.
No Years are gained from the Prologue. Proceed to the first interlude, then Loop 1.
cards.flavor: The occultation completes. Something reaches through — and does not finish reaching. The night folds. You are standing in the Square again at eleven o'clock, salt on your tongue, and you are the only ones who feel the seam.

cards.name: Light the Lamp
cards.text:
Objective — Once 4 clues have been discovered in the Lighthouse district, an investigator at the Lantern Room may test [com] or [wil] (3) to light the lamp. If they succeed, record "The Lamp Was Never Lit."
While the lamp is lit this loop, Echoes at connected districts stay Sleepwalking one band longer. In every later loop, place the Lantern Room calm side up.
cards.flavor: The lamp is dark. It has never, in any loop, been lit.

cards.text:
Act II only, once the log shows "The Lamp Was Never Lit."
Objective — With the lamp lit this loop, search the Keeper's Quarters (2 clues there) for the keeper's logbook. Record "The Keeper's Ninth Death."
Elias's elder-sign heal also removes 1 horror.

cards.name: Why Thirteen?
cards.text:
Objective — Once 6 clues have been discovered in the Drowned Church, an investigator at the Vestry may read the register. Record "The Thirteenth Toll."
Hour III no longer adds the Church's extra Dissonance.
cards.flavor: The bell tolled thirteen times at the first occultation. It should toll twelve.

cards.name: The Hour Was Wrong
cards.text:
Act II only, once the log shows "The Thirteenth Toll." The Flooded Crypt opens; the Bell-Ringer Beneath spawns there.
Objective — Recover the drowned almanac-page (3 clues in the Flooded Crypt). Record "The Hour Was Wrong."
Remove Hour IV from the Occultation for all future loops.

cards.name: Walk It Backward
cards.text:
Objective — Move through all three locations in reverse of the Echoes' direction (the Turning, then the Low Bridge, then the Milestones), discovering at least 1 clue at each. Record "The Road Remembers."
Once per loop, travel to or from the Lighthouse via the Sunken Road costs 0 Hours.
cards.flavor: The same figures walk it every loop, in the same direction, never arriving.

cards.name: Who Walks Beside You
cards.text:
Act II only, once the log shows "The Road Remembers."
Objective — At the Turning, evade an awakened Echo or hold it ([action] Hold: test [wil] or [com] (X), where X is its fight; if you succeed, exhaust it — like Hold Back, this pushes it back without harming it). Then read the face beneath the hood. Record "Who Walks Beside You."
Echoes get -1 fight against investigators who have this fact.
cards.flavor: Some of them turn to look at you now.

cards.name: The Sheriff Is Already Dead
cards.text:
Objective — Once 5 clues have been discovered in the Square district, an investigator at the Well may examine the body. Record "The Sheriff Is Already Dead."
From now on, once per loop, an investigator at the Town Hall Steps may look at the top card of the Occultation.
cards.flavor: He has been dead since ten o'clock. No one has noticed but you.

cards.name: The Vote That Never Ends
cards.text:
Act II only, once the log shows "The Sheriff Is Already Dead." When this objective is attempted, What Wears the Sheriff spawns at the Records Office.
Objective — Find the ledger in the Records Office (3 clues there). Record "The Vote That Never Ends" and advance Seraphine's thread, "Who Opened the Door."
cards.flavor: Ending the loop cleanly requires a cost the town agreed to pay.

cards.name: The Wheel Still Turns
cards.text:
Objective — An investigator at the Wheel may test [agi] (3) to ride it. If they succeed, they discover 2 clues from a height (from any location in the Fairground). Record "The Wheel Still Turns."
Once per loop, from the Wheel, you may look at the top 2 encounter cards and reorder them.
cards.flavor: You see the whole town at once.

cards.name: The Ticket-Taker's Bargain
cards.text:
Act II only, once the log shows "The Wheel Still Turns."
Objective — An investigator at the Ticket Booth may speak with the ticket-taker. He offers a way to end the night that is not free. Record "The Ticket-Taker's Bargain" and mark on the log that the bargain was heard.
cards.flavor: He smiles at you like he's been expecting you for a very long time.

cards.name: What the Almanac Hid
cards.text:
Objective — Once 2 [perinv] clues have been discovered in the Almanac House, an investigator at the Press may set it to reprint the true occultation time. Record "What the Almanac Hid."
At Hour VI, investigators remove a Static token instead of adding one.
cards.flavor: Where the wrong almanac was printed.

cards.name: The Appointed's Name
cards.text:
Act II only, once the log shows "What the Almanac Hid" and "The Vote That Never Ends." The Sealed Study opens.
Objective — Recover the name inside the Sealed Study (3 clues there). Record "The Appointed's Name"; this completes "Who Opened the Door." The Appointed now arrives exhausted at Hour VII.
Once you know "The Appointed's Name," "The Vote That Never Ends," and any one other deep fact, record "The Way the Night Breaks." The finale may now be attempted.
cards.flavor: Inside is the name the town spoke to call the thing through.

cards.name: Contest the Crossing
cards.text:
Only once the log shows "The Way the Night Breaks": declared by an investigator at the Sealed Study, or when the Hourglass reaches Hour IX (then set it back to Hour V instead of resetting; no Hour resolves). The Appointed's Approach advances to Arrived; it manifests at the location farthest from the investigators if not already on the board. Dissonance does not reset.
Objective — Before the Hourglass reaches Hour IX, gain contest progress equal to 4 × the number of investigators (12 at three players): 1 for each Hold Back success, 1 for each deep fact spent, and 1 the first time each investigator is at the Sealed Study during the finale.
When the finale ends, read the first resolution that qualifies: R1, R1b, then R2 to R6.
cards.flavor: An appointment made in ink and never kept.

cards.name: Take Its Place
cards.text:
Contest reached and an Ancient investigator is present.
One Ancient becomes the night's new anchor — kept behind, decades older, so the loop ends for everyone else. Mark them kept as anchor. The town wakes for the first time in a hundred years.
If "Who Walks Beside You" is known, instead: the ones who walk the Sunken Road take the anchor's weight with you. At dawn the Ancient walks out with the others — +3 Years, but free and not kept.

cards.name: Let It In, On Your Terms
cards.text:
Contest reached, "The Ticket-Taker's Bargain" is known, and banked Memory is 12 or more. The party may decline this and read on to R2.
You take the ticket-taker's offer: the door opens on your terms, not the town's, and the night finally ends. The fare is everything you carried — banked Memory drops to 0 — and each investigator present ages +2 Years. Ambergrove wakes to a morning with one more guest in it.
cards.flavor: He punches your ticket without looking. He has been expecting you for a very long time.

cards.name: Close the Door
cards.text:
Contest reached and you know "The Vote That Never Ends" and "The Appointed's Name."
You pay the price the town agreed to and never paid: everyone present ages +3 Years at once, and the door closes. The cleanest true ending — bought with years.

cards.name: Break Through
cards.text:
Contest reached and "The Keeper's Ninth Death" is known.
You force the night open and all survivors escape — but the loop is only paused. Was it really ended?

cards.name: Seal by Force
cards.text:
Contest reached.
The door is sealed but not closed; one investigator (chosen) ages out doing it.

cards.name: Next Time
cards.text:
Contest not reached, but banked Memory is 12 or more.
The loop wins tonight — but you wake at First Dark closer than ever. Begin a new loop; the finale may be re-attempted.

cards.name: The Loop Wins
cards.text:
Contest not reached and banked Memory is below 12.
The night takes you. The campaign ends.
cards.flavor: The town keeps repeating — and somewhere on the Sunken Road, walking the same direction and never arriving, there are new faces beneath the hoods.

cards.name: The Shape of the Hour
cards.text:
Read at the interlude when Act II begins (3 or more surface facts known, or after Loop 3).
The town has begun to notice that you notice. Somewhere past the edge of the Square, something that has been waiting politely decides to stop waiting.
From the next loop: deep objectives open and the Appointed's Whispers join the encounter deck.

cards.name: The Last Hour
cards.text: You know the shape of the night now. You know what it costs to end it. The only question left is who pays.
cards.flavor: You have lived this night more times than you can hold.
You came to Ambergrove for your own reasons. You will not remember why, soon.
The congregation is still here. They have been kneeling since the first toll.
The road between the town and the shore, counted out in stones that never change.
The water never quite reaches the top. It never quite goes down.
The occultation fair, mid-celebration, forever.
